ratings.comment: Very caring about his students and super passionate about the material. Lectures were informative and very interesting, even for those taking it as an easy Gen Ed. The grading is very flexible, and dropping an exam made the final optional for many. Highly recommend for physical science, as it's an interesting class without a huge time commitment.

The professor is interesting to listen to in lectures and the class is pretty easy. It has a bit more math than expected, but the math is basic algebra and ratios (you get formula sheets for exams). the exam questions are fair, and so is the grading. I would recommend.
An optional textbook, attendance is required for discussions but not for the lecture. Good professor who is helpful and gives you everything you need to get a good grade in his class.

Everything is very organized and clearly outlined. Lecture attendance not required, but discussion attendance is. Optional textbook. Graded on discussion exercises, 10 mc homework assignments, and mc exams. 3 midterms and a final, but can drop one exam score. Not the most interesting lecturer but explains material well.
